name: SECP Industrial OS v2 - Engineering Truth Platform
description: An advanced industrial engineering kernel and OS featuring multi-physics solvers (CFD/FEM/Thermal), B-Rep geometry, and CAM toolpathing, governed by a rigorous 5-Gate Acceptance framework. Built on the 'Engineering Truth' philosophy with deterministic clocks, cryptographic provenance, and a strict separation between production code, Vitest suites, and acceptance gates.
